_comment: Legal Matching Pokéballs 2.1 - the community's list of Poké Balls that match each Pokémon by colour or theme, up to three for the regular colouring and three for the shiny. Compiled by reddit.com/user/OracleLink (original spreadsheet design by reddit.com/user/adamlutz); the sheet's Pokémon sprites are hosted by Pokejungle.net. The sheet draws the balls as pictures, so it was exported to PDF by the tracker's author on 2026-09-22 and read back image by image: every ball picture in every tab is byte-identical to one of the 27 labelled pictures in the sheet's own Pokéball Key, which is how each cell was named (MIGRATION_GUIDE.md §398). Names are the sheet's own spellings - forms in parentheses as it writes them ('Raticate (Alola)') - with three corrections: its 'Palpitoed' and 'Seismitoed' are Palpitoad and Seismitoad, and its third Paldean Tauros, whose '(Aqua' did not survive the export, is 'Tauros (Aqua Breed)'. genderDifferences marks the sheet's asterisk; shinyUnavailable marks a cell the sheet labels 'Not available'. Three Pokémon point elsewhere in the sheet and carry no balls of their own: Vivillon and Alcremie (their tabs are the vivillon and alcremie sections below) and Arceus with a plate (see byType). The sheet's four unlabelled Squawkabilly cells and the second Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus cells are labelled here in the sheet's order (Green, Blue, Yellow, White Plumage; Incarnate then Therian). byType is the intro tab's 'Unique Poké Balls by Type' column: its type labels did not survive the export, so the types are assumed to run in the standard order - use it with that in mind.
